message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine. Against a plain white background, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, red, serif capital letters. Below this, the words "KORTING GANJIL VONIS MATI" are written in bold, black, sans-serif block letters. Small text above the main title reads, "KISAH PEMBELOT ASSAD | CENTURY DI TANGAN KPK," and smaller text below "TEMPO" reads "EDISI 26 NOVEMBER-2 DESEMBER 2012."

The central image features a white plastic syringe with a metal needle pointing upwards at a slight angle. The syringe contains a beige liquid and is marked with a black skull and crossbones symbol. A brown wooden judge’s gavel is draped over the needle. The gavel is bent in the middle like soft rubber, forming a "V" shape where it rests on the needle. One end of the gavel is a rounded handle, and the other is a cylindrical head. The syringe and gavel appear to float in space. In the bottom left corner, there is a price of "RP 29.700," a website address, and a barcode. A thick red border runs along the left and bottom edges of the cover.
